vendor/libheif-1.19.8.js is the pure-JavaScript (Emscripten) build of libheif, unmodified,
from the npm package libheif-js 1.19.8:
  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/libheif-js@1.19.8/libheif/libheif.js
It includes libheif (https://github.com/strukturag/libheif) and the libde265 HEVC decoder
(https://github.com/strukturag/libde265), both licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public
License v3 (see libheif-LICENSE.txt). Build scripts and sources:
https://github.com/catdad-experiments/libheif-js

Inspicio uses it, in a Web Worker, only to decode HEIC/HEIF photos in browsers that can't
(Chrome, Firefox). It is a separate file and can be replaced with any compatible build.
